response.rationale: The order is apparel, not final sale, and delivered 41 days ago. Although the customer describes the sweatshirt stretching and unraveling, the facts record defective == False, so the defective-item rule (RET-020) does not apply. With days_since_delivery (41) > 30 and final_sale == False, RET-008 controls and the return is not accepted beyond the 30-day window.
